Worlds with ores 1.2.2 for Minecraft Forge 1.20.1

SUMMARY
- Portal worlds, soft industrial terrain, Lava Obsidian tools/armor
- Portal Flux energy is WORK IN PROGRESS (playable prototype)

CHANGES IN 1.2.2
- Fixed reactor GUI layout (modules no longer overlap the core animation)
- Clear coil upgrade feedback + item tooltips (right-click coils with upgrades)
- Marked Portal Flux items/UI/book as WIP
- Fixed Lava Obsidian sword model (now normal handheld icon)
- Earlier 1.2.1: denser portal worldgen, sparse netherbrick decor

CURSEFORGE UPLOAD
1. Upload: dist/curseforge/worlds_with_ores-1.2.2-1.20.1.jar
2. Game versions: Forge 1.20.1
3. Release type: Beta (energy WIP)
4. Paste CHANGELOG_CF.txt into the changelog field
